fixture.notes: Each stage script picks real-DSL when the relevant jar is found locally; falls back to the pre-compiled synthetic subclass + ClassLoader.defineClass path otherwise. Both paths exercise the WP2.3 defineClass entry points, but only the real-DSL form satisfies the spec's acceptance text literally.

cglib.notes: Real CglibProbe2 reaches CGLIB's net.sf.cglib.core.ReflectUtils.<clinit>, which reflectively looks up ClassLoader.defineClass(String,byte[],int,int,ProtectionDomain). That overload is currently missing/unwired in cratonvm — see WP2.3-C. Pre-clinit dispatch already works (`pre-toString=Target#toString` reaches stdout). Once 2.3-A/B/C land, expected_final_rc flips to 0 and stdout gains 'OK'. The synthetic CglibProbe (jar absent fallback) NPEs on `getCodeSource` instead — also WP2.3-C territory.

bytebuddy.notes: Real ByteBuddyProbe trips inside ByteBuddy's net.bytebuddy.utility.dispatcher.JavaDispatcher.<clinit> with NPE on arraylength null at java/lang/reflect/Method pc=5. ByteBuddy walks Method[] arrays (WP2.1 reflection coverage) before reaching defineClass (WP2.3). Once 2.1 + 2.3-A/B/C land, expected_final_rc flips to 0 and stdout gains the four 'step N OK' lines + 'OK'.

steps.name: stage-cglib
steps.notes: javac --release 21 of synthetic family. If cglib jar found, also compiles CglibProbe2 with jar on cp. Skip-with-message on jar absence.

steps.name: stage-bytebuddy
steps.notes: javac --release 21 of synthetic family. If byte-buddy jar found, also compiles ByteBuddyProbe with jar on cp. Skip-with-message on jar absence.

steps.name: run
steps.notes: cratonvm fails on both probes — see per-probe `expected_stderr_contains`. The harness still exits 0; the per-probe rc / meta are pinned in summary.json. Future agents diff summary.json against this baseline to detect drift.

known_blockers.summary: classloading/src/class_manager.rs::define_class_with_options must accept a class-bytes blob, parse, link, and register without depending on a backing on-disk classfile.
native-builtins/src/unsafe_natives.rs::defineClass must route to define_class_with_options (currently throws or stubs).
native-builtins/src/classloader.rs::ClassLoader.defineClass family must route into the same class_manager API and propagate ProtectionDomain so getCodeSource() doesn't NPE.

definition_of_pass: All three blockers above land. summary.json reports rc=0 for both probes, with main_class=CglibProbe2 and main_class=ByteBuddyProbe (i.e. real DSL paths exercised, not just synthetic placeholders). At that point: clear all expected_stderr_contains entries, set expected_final_rc=0 for both probes, and add 'OK' to expected_stdout_contains for both probes.
update_policy: Update this file in lockstep with any 2.3-A/B/C landing. Bump generated_at. The diff-baseline tool (TBD — for now humans inspect summary.json by hand) compares last-run-* artifacts against the per-probe expected_* sets.
